summary: Test only: two message-selector tests no longer assume a commit finishes folding its selectors. A commit folds for at most 10 ms of wall time, so on a loaded host a subject could still be pending. fractal-store's retired-headers test now folds its seed before taking the cut and folds loan by loan until the first subject's header is retired. fractal-api-core's cursor tests fold their fixture messages before the first page.

replay.detail: No record, signature or storage format changes.
